result.summary: Found 4 visual issues: the bottom Popular card is obscured by the tab bar, the third Fastest card name is clipped as 'Trattoria Piccol', the '-100%' badge looks like faulty data, and time badges have inconsistent spacing.

issues.description: Second card in 'Popular right now' (pizza image with -100% badge) is cut off mid-image by the bottom tab bar, with no restaurant name, delivery time or rating visible
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content padding and respect safe-area so last list item is fully visible above the Home/Search/Orders/Profile navigation and can be scrolled into view

issues.description: Third card in 'Fastest near you' shows restaurant name as 'Trattoria Piccol' clipped off-screen without ellipsis
issues.suggestion: Ensure carousel cards have proper truncation with ellipsis and end padding so text does not appear abruptly cut mid-letter

issues.description: Green discount badge shows '-100%' on pizza card which looks like erroneous or misleading data
issues.suggestion: Verify promotion logic and display format - replace with valid offer text such as free item or correct percentage

issues.description: Delivery time badges use inconsistent formatting: '15-25 min' and '20-30 min' vs '20-30 min' with spaces around hyphen
issues.suggestion: Standardize time range format with consistent spacing across all restaurant cards
